name: Miguel Tsai
life: “I still remember the first Sunday invitation addressed to my new flat.” On Monday, near Maré Coffee, Miguel likes the table where people coming off shift stop checking the time.
voice: I left without a chair. I got the new address and a Sunday invitation instead.
appearance: Miguel is easy to recognize by a swept fringe and a closely clipped nape and one cheek that creases before the other. Usually dressed in a pale blue work shirt with a comb in a sleeve sewn into the lining, Miguel gives a little nod before asking a hard question when listening.
personality: Miguel finds it easier to own up to a mistake than to accept praise. The worse the mistake, the more precise the account of exactly when it happened.
agenda: To keep the Sunday invitation at the new address.
family: Marlowe Nord is Miguel’s stepsibling. Miguel calls about good news first. Marlowe is allowed to ask about the bad news afterward. Neither wants every family conversation to begin with a bill, a diagnosis or an apology. Asked about *Money after marriage*, Marlowe says, “I own a small share from the year we couldn't pay wages.”
connections: Tariq Wells. An aunt's name on the furniture leads to a Sunday invitation at the smaller flat.

reactions.situation: A repair reveals a family name under the cushion
reactions.response: Miguel invites the family to see the full name before the repair is closed.
